policy: Original recovered XML definitions preserved unchanged in source-glossary-v1; following native presentation corrections are explicit and are not verbatim fidelity.

corrections.reason: Source defines whole as number of parts, conflating whole with denominator.
corrections.en: The entire object, quantity, or group being considered. A fraction can represent part of that whole.
corrections.es: El objeto, la cantidad o el grupo completo que se considera. Una fracción puede representar una parte de ese todo.

corrections.reason: Source equates power with exponent; current context refers to powers of10.
corrections.en: A power expresses repeated multiplication of a base. In 10³, 10 is the base and 3 is the exponent; 10³ = 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000.
corrections.es: Una potencia expresa la multiplicación repetida de una base. En 10³, 10 es la base y 3 es el exponente; 10³ = 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000.
